Projects.title: Sistuber
desc: Designed the UI/UX for Sistuber, a digital healthcare application focused on supporting the tuberculosis (TB) screening process. Conducted user research to understand user needs and challenges, developed user flows, and designed 65+ wireframes and high-fidelity screens using Figma. Created interactive prototypes to visualize user journeys and conducted usability testing to identify usability issues and improve the overall user experience. Collaborated directly with stakeholders to gather requirements, discuss feedback, and refine the design based on project needs.

Projects.title: BatikEye
desc: BatikEye is an interactive batik motif recognition website built to support cultural education and preservation. The platform allows users to upload batik images and receive motif recognition results through an integrated machine learning model.

I built the front-end using React.js, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript, and Axios, then integrated it with a RESTful API developed by the back-end and machine learning teams. The system connects with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and a TensorFlow CNN model for batik image recognition with over 90% accuracy.
The project is available through its GitHub repository and was developed as an educational tool that introduces batik motifs through a modern and interactive web experience.

Projects.title: TechTrove
desc: TechTrove is a modern e-commerce website designed specifically for selling electronic and technology products such as smartphones, laptops, smart home devices, and other digital accessories. The platform focuses on providing a safe, simple, and efficient shopping experience for users.

The website includes product search and filtering by category, price, and brand, complete product detail pages with specifications, images, and customer reviews, secure checkout through payment gateway integration, order tracking, account management, and rating and review features.

I built the responsive front-end using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, while the back-end was developed with PHP and integrated with MySQL to manage product data, user accounts, orders, reviews, and transaction records in a structured database.

Projects.title: Dashboard Pusat Penelitian dan Penerbitan UIN Jakarta
desc: Dashboard Pusat Penelitian dan Penerbitan UIN Jakarta is an administrative dashboard built to centralize research, publication, incentive, article registration, reference book, faculty, and research year data in one structured system.

I worked as a Project-Based Fullstack Developer, developing dashboard summaries, data visualization charts, period-based reporting, CRUD modules, search and filtering features, and responsive admin interfaces using Laravel Filament and Blade.

The system was built with PHP, Laravel, Filament, Blade, MySQL, and Tailwind CSS to support efficient data management, research performance monitoring, and administrative workflows for the research and publishing center.

Projects.title: Susi Air Pilot Operations Dashboard
desc: Developed a mobile-first Pilot Operations Dashboard as part of a Fullstack Developer technical recruitment assessment for Susi Air. The application provides pilot operational management features, including flight-hour tracking, duty schedules, document expiration monitoring, flight-hour limit calculations, and interactive data visualization.

Implemented the frontend using Nuxt 3, Vue 3, TypeScript, Pinia, and Chart.js, with a NestJS REST API backend. The application uses read-only JSON data as its data source and supports responsive layouts for desktop and mobile devices.
Independently developed as part of a recruitment technical assessment. This is not an official Susi Air product.

Projects.title: IndoKerja Recruitment Platform
desc: Developed a fullstack job recruitment platform as part of a technical assessment for IndoKerja. The application simulates an end-to-end recruitment process: job seekers can explore vacancies, submit applications, and track application statuses, while companies can publish vacancies and manage candidates throughout the recruitment process.

Implemented the frontend using React, TypeScript, and Vite, with a Node.js and Express REST API backend. Integrated PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM for database management and implemented authentication using JWT in HttpOnly cookies, password hashing with bcrypt, and input validation using Zod.
Independently developed as part of a technical assessment. This is a recruitment process simulation, not an official IndoKerja production platform.
